meta.name: campaign-angle-finder
meta.description: Analyzes a target persona and context to generate 3 distinct campaign angles for outbound sequences. Use this skill whenever the user wants to find the right angle for a campaign, asks "what angle should I use for this persona", "give me campaign ideas for this target", "how should I approach this audience", or provides a target and some context before writing emails. Always produces exactly 3 differentiated angles with rationale, campaign hook, and pain focus for each.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为外呼序列生成3个差异化营销角度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为特定人群设计外呼邮件，需要找到最打动他们的切入点。
copy.tagline_en: Generate 3 distinct campaign angles for outbound sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing outbound emails for a specific persona and need the right angle to engage them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会分析你提供的目标人物画像和背景，生成3个不同的推广活动角度，每个角度包含痛点、开场白和话术逻辑。
howto.when: 当你询问“这个人物用什么角度”、“给我这个目标的推广活动想法”、“如何接近这个受众”，或提供目标和背景后触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个销售线索，找三个推广角度。
say.note: Claude会要求补充信息后生成3个角度。

say.text: 我想针对CTO写推广邮件，给点角度。
say.note: Claude会分析CTO的痛点并生成角度。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes a target persona and context you provide, then generates 3 distinct campaign angles, each with a core tension, campaign hook, and sequence logic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "what angle should I use for this persona", "give me campaign ideas for this target", "how should I approach this audience", or provide a target and context.

say_en.text: Analyze this sales lead and find three campaign angles.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details and then generate angles.

say_en.text: I need email angles for a CTO persona.
say_en.note: Claude deconstructs the persona and produces angles.
